transformations.name: bh_test_uhc_roster_IngestFilter
transformations.condition: batch_id_src_1 = max_batch_id AND (corrupt_record_src_1 IS NULL OR corrupt_record_src_1 = '')

derived_fields.name: source_system
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN market_src_1 = 'UHC C+S Maryland' THEN 'UHC MD' WHEN market_src_1 = 'UHC C+S West Virginia' THEN 'UHC WV' ELSE market_src_1 END

derived_fields.name: member_group
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN (curr_vendor_tin_src_1 IS NULL OR curr_vendor_tin_src_1 = '' OR curr_vendor_tin_src_1 = '999999999') AND (curr_vendor_name_src_1 IS NULL OR curr_vendor_name_src_1 = '') THEN 'No Group Name' ELSE curr_vendor_name_src_1 END

derived_fields.name: tin
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN curr_vendor_tin_src_1 IS NULL OR curr_vendor_tin_src_1 = '' THEN '999999999' ELSE curr_vendor_tin_src_1 END

derived_fields.name: tin_market
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN market_src_1 = 'UHC C+S West Virginia' THEN 'WV' WHEN market_src_1 = 'UHC C+S Maryland' THEN 'MD' ELSE market_src_1 END

derived_fields.name: tin_submarket
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN market_src_1 = 'UHC C+S West Virginia' THEN 'WV' WHEN market_src_1 = 'UHC C+S Maryland' THEN 'MD' ELSE market_src_1 END

derived_fields.name: pcp_name
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN curr_pcp_last_name_src_1 = 'MEDICARE PCP' AND (curr_pcp_npi_src_1 IS NULL OR curr_pcp_npi_src_1 = '') THEN curr_pcp_last_name_src_1 WHEN concat(coalesce(curr_pcp_first_name_src_1, ''), ' ', coalesce(curr_pcp_last_name_src_1, '')) IS NULL OR trim(concat(coalesce(curr_pcp_first_name_src_1, ''), ' ', coalesce(curr_pcp_last_name_src_1, ''))) = '' THEN 'No PCP Name' ELSE concat(coalesce(curr_pcp_first_name_src_1, ''), ' ', coalesce(curr_pcp_last_name_src_1, '')) END

derived_fields.name: pcp_npi
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN curr_pcp_npi_src_1 IS NULL OR curr_pcp_npi_src_1 = '' THEN '9999999999' ELSE curr_pcp_npi_src_1 END

derived_fields.name: member_plan
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN source_system = 'UHC MD' AND line_of_business_desc_src_1 = 'MD Medicare Dual SNP' THEN 'DSNP' WHEN source_system = 'UHC WV' AND line_of_business_desc_src_1 = 'WV M&R DSNP' THEN 'DSNP' ELSE plan_desc_src_1 END

derived_fields.name: phone_type
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN patient_phone_type_src_1 IS NOT NULL THEN patient_phone_type_src_1 ELSE 'HOME' END
